# From The Fog — upstream source copy

This directory contains an unmodified source copy of [From The Fog](https://github.com/LunarEclipseStudios/From-The-Fog) by Lunar Eclipse Studios, at commit `cd14b43c623d73b1c3efe8a9b7a1f734f4e1f408` (main).

The upstream files are licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; see `LICENSE.md` and the upstream `README.md` for attribution and redistribution information. This source copy is separate from Herobrine: Haunting and is not included in its Fabric build. The upstream repository does not include a `pack.mcmeta` at its root, so this directory alone is not a ready-to-install datapack.

`WAKE_UP.vbs` is an upstream Windows script. It displays a series of message boxes and opens a website; it is not required for the mod or datapack. Do not run it unless you intend that behavior.
